task.pr_title: Transformations: Fix Timeseries to table transformation trend reduction when result is 0

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
You're correct in that this check should not be `|| null`. But looking at the implementation of `reduceField` it seems to return undefined if the field has no values and [`reducer.emptyInputResult`](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/blob/b607a4e0a2ee2a9b368c6ebcf4021249768b347e/packages/grafana-data/src/transformations/fieldReducer.ts#L90C19-L90C19) is undefined. It could be that the check in reduceField is wrong, and it should really check if emptyInputResult is undefined.

In any case, I think the change here should be to check if the FieldCalc is undefined. Adding a test with a field that has no values would also be a good idea.
